conditionDefinitions.description: An independent human takeover or emergency-stop path is armed and observed healthy.
The detected firmware family, version, and immutable identity satisfy the selected Vehicle Pack contract.
A native/runtime challenge binds the request to the expected physical controller and vehicle identity.
The selected module or Vehicle Pack hash and signature verify against an active trust anchor.
A local human explicitly confirms the safety-critical action after reviewing the exact target and diff.
The prescribed telemetry, sensor, power, geofence, parameter, and control-link preflight completed without bypass.
A supported external QGroundControl installation is discovered without bundling or silently executing arbitrary paths.
A trusted compatible Sim/HITL qualification receipt exists, or the edition executes the prescribed hardware safety preflight.
A verified parameter/configuration snapshot exists and the transaction can restore it after a partial failure.
The configured operating area, altitude, and emergency boundaries are valid for the detected vehicle and operator policy.
A signed, compatible, unrevoked qualification receipt binds the exact Vehicle Pack, firmware, Engine Pack, Runtime Base, and scenario contract.
The update is immutable, signature-verified, source-bound, and has a compatible rollback target.
The signed Vehicle Pack supports the edition, target, autopilot, controller, firmware, and installed module set.

sim.reason: The Sim edition keeps its control surface inside the simulation-only product boundary.

lab.reason: Lab may launch a separately installed GCS after native path and version validation.

field.reason: Field may launch a separately installed GCS after native path and version validation.

sim.reason: Simulation-only builds must reject physical and HITL arming below the UI.

lab.reason: Lab arming is available only through the full hardware safety fence.

field.reason: Field arming is available only through the full hardware safety fence.

sim.reason: Simulation-only builds must not enumerate or claim physical hardware.

lab.reason: Lab may discover hardware through the native identity boundary.

field.reason: Field may discover hardware through the native identity boundary.

sim.reason: The Sim edition has no physical target to stop.

lab.reason: Lab exposes the independently fenced emergency path for the verified target.

field.reason: Field exposes the independently fenced emergency path for the verified target.

sim.reason: Simulation-only builds must reject physical flight below the UI.

lab.reason: Lab real flight is gated by target identity, qualification, preflight, local confirmation, and takeover.

field.reason: Field real flight is gated by target identity, qualification, preflight, local confirmation, and takeover.

sim.reason: The Sim edition does not connect a physical controller.

lab.reason: Lab HITL requires verified hardware and the same explicit safety boundary as real flight.

field.reason: Field omits the simulator closure and may consume trusted HITL evidence but cannot execute HITL.

sim.reason: Simulation-only builds must not open a physical parameter channel.

lab.reason: Lab may read parameters only from the bound supported target.

field.reason: Field may read parameters only from the bound supported target.

sim.reason: Simulation-only builds must reject physical parameter writes below the UI.

lab.reason: Lab parameter writes are transactional, bounded, qualified, and locally confirmed.

field.reason: Field parameter writes are transactional, bounded, qualified, and locally confirmed.

sim.reason: The Sim edition has no physical preflight path.

lab.reason: Lab may execute the pack-defined physical preflight without granting arm or flight authority.

field.reason: Field may execute the pack-defined physical preflight without granting arm or flight authority.

sim.reason: Sim may issue evidence-bound qualification receipts after the complete simulator gate.

lab.reason: Lab may issue evidence-bound qualification receipts after the complete simulator gate.

field.reason: Field does not contain the large simulator closure required to issue simulator qualification.

sim.reason: Sim produces qualification evidence but does not authorize physical actions.

lab.reason: Lab may consume only a compatible, signed, unrevoked qualification receipt.

field.reason: Field may consume only a compatible, signed, unrevoked qualification receipt.

lab.reason: Lab includes the same simulation core as Sim.

field.reason: Field omits the large simulation module by default and cannot silently download or execute it.

sim.reason: Sim may write bounded parameters only to the verified SITL target and must restore after a partial failure.

lab.reason: Lab may write bounded parameters to the verified SITL target under the same transaction contract.

field.reason: Field has no simulation parameter channel.

sim.reason: Simulated arming is allowed only after the launcher proves the target is SITL and healthy.

lab.reason: Lab uses the same SITL target proof before simulated arming.

field.reason: Field has no simulated arming capability.

sim.reason: Sim modules update atomically from signed, source-bound artifacts.

lab.reason: Lab modules update atomically from signed, source-bound artifacts.

field.reason: Field modules update atomically from signed, source-bound artifacts.

sim.reason: Sim installs only signed simulation modules compatible with the edition.

lab.reason: Lab installs only signed modules compatible with its simulator and hardware policies.

field.reason: Field installs only signed hardware and validation modules compatible with the lightweight edition.
